headline: A weekend in sound.
intro: Three sessions for curious ears. Settle into the courtyard, follow a field recording after dark, or bring a record to the Sunday exchange.

items.label: Fri · 18:30
items.title: Courtyard frequencies
items.detail: Meet in the courtyard for an open-air listening session built from tape loops and live percussion. Seating opens at 18:00.

items.label: Sat · 20:00
items.title: Night field notes
items.detail: Join a guided walk from the north gate. Field recordists share the sounds they collect along the river. Bring comfortable shoes.

items.label: Sun · 11:00
items.title: The record exchange
items.detail: Bring one record and a story about it to the listening bar. Each guest gets a turn on the house turntable.
